economy.zh:
**经济板块导语**：全球风险资产在6月26日迎来剧烈分化——中东地缘脉冲式冲击消退后，市场焦点重回AI基建成本焦虑与央行鹰派信号。亚太科技股领跌（恒生科技指数周跌幅超5%），欧洲消费者信心塌陷阻碍复苏，而美联储内部对通胀路径仍存分歧。中国A股在量能破2.5万亿背景下上演「万亿龙头大跌」的筹码博弈，汽车价格战与半导体并购则暗藏结构性机会。

- **油价逻辑反转**：伊朗袭击事件后油轮主动撤离霍尔木兹海峡，但布伦特原油反跌至72.24美元/桶（低于2月战争前水平），显示市场押注供应过剩而非地缘溢价。CNBC报道[Oil slides 2%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oil-prices-middle-east-iran-strait-of-hormuz-opec-iraq-wti-brent-crude.html)与《卫报》[Oil price falls to pre-Iran war levels](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/25/oil-price-falls-pre-iran-war-levels-more-tankers-exit-strait-of-hormuz)相互印证，投资者应警惕油价二次探底对能源股和通胀预期的压制。
- **AI基建成本恐慌蔓延**：软银暴跌13%、SK海力士跌10%之后，亚洲科技股全线溃退；[SoftBank plunges 13%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/global-tech-stocks-ai-infrastructure-costs-selloff-softbank-apple.html)揭示市场从「AI受益叙事」转向「投入回报怀疑」。同日ON半导体70亿美元收购Synaptics布局物理AI，[ON Semi strikes $7B deal](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/25/on-semi-synaptics-deal-physical-ai.html)却难以扭转板块悲观情绪。
- **监管重锤指向科技巨头**：欧盟初步拟将AWS和Azure纳入《数字市场法案》[EU moves to expand big tech rules](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNR2lOSUE4aFBZSndhcjRkOExNdEpvTVRETkZrdGduM3A5RlFLcjAyaEdBSEp1TFFuMWdMMWluY3hqdzRkd3hhVVhOZm1zUHhwLWgyd1FEZ3hIcHJNRmRfaEJxU044M0RPRGc0dGNickFmNWh0OXFFT2t1YzNTdlY3V3FrR1pjMUd0TjNvQW85RUd4VG9LYWw1UDFadjJ0ZGFpTUhGUEFLc3pOUl85QnVabEdiby1YcUp0N2FEMUVqUWtaWXlrSzZNUlI1RQ)，与美国FCC对迪士尼的调查形成跨大西洋监管共振，云服务定价与数据主权将成为未来数年风险变量。
- **中国汽车市场「生存淘汰」**：156款新车将于下半年涌入，价格战逼近10万元区间[‘Do or die’ for small carmakers](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358193/do-or-die-small-carmakers-china-market-braces-156-new-models-price-war-looms)，叠加携程面临的「重大反垄断罚款」预警[Trip.com faces revenue slowdown](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3358354/chinas-tripcom-faces-revenue-slowdown-warns-significant-fine-antitrust-probe)，消费与监管双重压力下的内需企业需谨慎筛选。

**后续关注**：（1）7月美联储会议前，核心PCE与Goolsbee「通胀过高」表态是否升级为降息推迟预期；（2）霍尔木兹海峡船只遇袭后，联合国暂停船舶撤离计划[UN agency pauses Hormuz ship evacuation](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/strait-of-hormuz-vessel-attack-evacuation-pauses-iran-united-states-peace-deal-negotiation-)可能再度推高地缘风险溢价；（3）中国A股下周是否因半年末流动性紧张出现极端波动。
economy.en:
Markets this week were dominated by a sharp tech selloff that rippled from the US to Asia, while oil prices defied geopolitical jitters to slide below pre-conflict levels. Central bank messaging remained hawkish on both sides of the Atlantic, and the EU took a significant step toward regulating cloud services, targeting Amazon and Microsoft. In China, a new wave of auto price wars and antitrust scrutiny on Trip.com underscored the fragile recovery, even as Hong Kong pushed ahead with financial infrastructure upgrades.

- **Global tech rout deepens**: SoftBank plunged 13% and SK Hynix fell 10% on rising AI infrastructure costs ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/global-tech-stocks-ai-infrastructure-costs-selloff-softbank-apple.html)). The Hang Seng Index was on track for its worst week in over a year (-5.8%) as tech names tumbled ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358428/hang-seng-index-heads-worst-week-over-year-renewed-sell-engulfs-tech-names)). US futures also dropped as the sector struggled to find its footing ([Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.)).

- **Oil slides despite Strait of Hormuz attack**: Brent crude fell to $72.24, back to pre-war levels, after a container ship was struck near Oman ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/25/oil-price-falls-pre-iran-war-levels-more-tankers-exit-strait-of-hormuz)). The UN paused its ship evacuation plan, and a US official blamed Iran ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/strait-of-hormuz-vessel-attack-evacuation-pauses-iran-united-states-peace-deal-negotiation-)). Markets looked past supply risks, focusing on the demand outlook.

- **Central bank divergence**: Chicago Fed’s Goolsbee said inflation is too high, while Fed’s Williams sees easing price pressures ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/25/chicago-fed-president-goolsbee-says-inflation-is-too-high-calls-warsh-a-serious-guy.html)). ECB’s Schnabel signaled more tightening even after the Iran ceasefire ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNMzR6T2RpMkdwcnM2VmFkVVVrVTFFOGpZOWloNmU3VWxXR2czdGsydU83TWthX2UyUU5NTjk5aDJheUVjenl4SUtJNUs4TVNHNHlhV1RmTmc5bnZmTE9tZm5rUEFkNDhnWUZ3dTRxV2FkMS1RcnpDTndhS3hEWjlHSnRrOFpfcGNJaHIxeDYyU1kydHd1TEc4)).

- **EU targets Big Tech cloud**: The European Commission reached a preliminary view that AWS and Azure should be designated under the Digital Markets Act ([Euractiv](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPYjJwTkZYOEI4NjByeTZnd3JhWkNKcVRidnk2VU95Q1RYZTZmV0pPR0Z2djh2SlYtc1hXQUpQc2dMTGp4b3RveTlLTXZmUmpSbkdqSF9CTHBzZGRuQ0hLcEhKSFVNeWYxb1ItRHoyRDZDYXIzT2VmMVlEYlJLSHQ4Nld0a2ZEdTVQcHhsZ3laQW51ekxZakFZVHV6TFotU0tv)). This could force changes in how the two giants operate in Europe.

- **China auto price war escalates**: A record 156 new models are expected in H2, pressuring small carmakers into a ‘do or die’ battle ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358193/do-or-die-small-carmakers-china-market-braces-156-new-models-price-war-looms)). Only leading EV makers with brand recognition are likely to survive.

- **Trip.com faces antitrust fine**: The online travel giant warned of a ‘significant fine’ from China’s market regulator and reported slowing revenue growth of 3–8% in Q2, its weakest in three years ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3358354/chinas-tripcom-faces-revenue-slowdown-warns-significant-fine-antitrust-probe)).

- **Watch next**: Friday’s FTSE Russell reconstitution will be one of the biggest volume days of the year ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/the-wall-street-equivalent-of-roster-cut-day-happens-friday-itll-be-one-of-the-biggest-volume-days-of-the-year-750e8496)). Keep an eye on how the tech rout impacts earnings season, and whether the EU’s cloud designation triggers a broader regulatory wave.

society.zh:
今日全球社会新闻呈现出多重危机与结构性变局。委内瑞拉遭遇双震级超7级浅源地震，已致至少235人死亡、4300人受伤，灾后救援在政治真空（前领导人马杜罗被美军抓捕不足半年）下举步维艰 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjegdqw5d3yo))；美国最高法院裁定允许终止海地和叙利亚移民的临时保护身份（TPS），数十万长期居留者面临遣返风险 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4g8ym422lko))；特朗普同时向国会施压要求拨款对伊朗战争，与共和党内部及北约盟友产生裂痕 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1eydwldzdjo))。东亚方面，日韩防长本周末将在首尔会晤，推动签署《获取与交叉服务协定》（ACSA），安全合作实质性升级 ([Anadolu Ajansı](https://news.google.))。中国社会层面，新华网发布关于青少年吸食“新型毒品”的调查，揭示隐秘危机 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwTEQzM1JqY0x3YTN3cDdwdEhyWWxrQ0FOaTNVUGJ2UEF4ZU82YmM2c2RGQXpMeC1yb3I3Q3dnbmdnSkc3UkJrZWV6T2Y0Nk1rN1ZjSXprTW9Ga19LWTB2SjdvcnhERHJhaUZtVl9RaHNXYXdyRzVJQXRaR2MtQQ))；知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源宣布加速AI商业化转型 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))。

**后续观察：** 委内瑞拉地震的国际救援响应与政治过渡能否同步，将是本周关键；美国TPS裁决可能引发大规模诉讼与人道危机；日韩防务合作升级或重塑东北亚安全格局；知乎的AI转型能否逆转营收颓势，值得关注其产品落地结果。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by dual seismic and geopolitical shocks. A devastating twin earthquake in Venezuela has killed at least 235, compounding the country's political uncertainty after the seizure of its former leader. Meanwhile, Trump's request for billions in war funding for Iran is setting up a bitter clash with his own party, and the Supreme Court has cleared the way to end protections for hundreds of thousands of Haitian and Syrian immigrants. In Asia, Japan and South Korea are moving to deepen defense ties, while a separate 7.2-magnitude quake struck northern Japan. China's state media focuses on ideological education, but a rare investigative report on youth drug abuse signals growing social concern.

- [Venezuela earthquakes kill at least 235, thousands injured](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjegdqw5d3yo) — Two shallow 7+ magnitude quakes seconds apart, with 4,300 injured and buildings collapsing in Caracas.
- [Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, facing Republican resistance](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1eydwldzdjo) — The budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with members of his own party.
- [Supreme Court allows Trump to end TPS for Haitians and Syrians](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4g8ym422lko) — Ruling opens path to deport hundreds of thousands who have lived in the US for years.
- [Israel’s cycle of conflict shows no finish line](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/26/forever-wars-israels-conflict-cycle-shows-no-finish-line) — Despite ceasefires, wars continue with no lasting security gains.
- [Paris restricts alcohol as Europe heatwave shifts east](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwy0pdq89zno) — Temperatures in Germany could hit 40°C; alcohol rules aim to ease hospital pressure.
- [Japan advances to World Cup knockout stage after draw with Sweden](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQNjFPdkFJZ2ZnM3dsekVDLTN3RjFWVkRscG1uTzJyclR4aFk2LU1EdU1jRUx0ekVyVTZ6ZHhMR1R2WjR3LUE5aWZkNlJvN2paT1FkeTdYSGcwaFNpdUN5ZVQwR2k5bnN5SWNGTy14RGtjdG5WMEZ5ZE14RHZNVHZNeTctR0FqYVN2XzlLb2puLW81SmNWdFhpdHE0cnNUOXBxS1E) — A moment of national pride amid broader regional tensions.
- [Chinese media report on youth 'new-type drug' abuse](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwTEQzM1JqY0x3YTN3cDdwdEhyWWxrQ0FOaTNVUGJ2UEF4ZU82YmM2c2RGQXpMeC1yb3I3Q3dnbmdnSkc3UkJrZWV6T2Y0Nk1rN1ZjSXprTW9Ga19LWTB2SjdvcnhERHJhaUZtVl9RaHNXYXdyRzVJQXRaR2MtQQ) — A rare investigative deep dive into rising synthetic drug use among adolescents.

**Watch next:** The Venezuela humanitarian crisis will deepen as rescue efforts continue. Watch for the Trump-NATO friction ahead of any Iran war vote, and the fallout from the TPS ruling for immigrant communities. The Japan-South Korea defense talks this weekend could reshape regional security postures.

military.zh:
今日军事新闻呈现三大主线：朝鲜首次列装“崔贤”级导弹驱逐舰并宣布建造万吨巡洋舰，正式迈入海军核武装化阶段；美国空军提出1000海里远程导弹计划，矛头直指中国反介入/区域拒止体系；伊朗战争持续冲击霍尔木兹海峡航运，全球能源通道面临威胁。此外，菲律宾部署美制无人侦察机、乌克兰无人机技术反导化、中美科技企业清单博弈等亦值得关注。

- **朝鲜海军核化加速**：6月23日，朝鲜正式列装首艘5000吨级“崔贤”级导弹驱逐舰，并宣布后续万吨巡洋舰计划，金正恩明确将推进海军核武装（[quwa.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOajJFMVZZckw1OHMzVFg4MW81WkdqRTFtdzRsYXRENkJkdnhzVmhmQUdGUWZEeUFYdVdSVDJHWGlRcUVwRHFPN0dveVkyU2JWYTctek4yVjVrSWdkR0Y4WVVJTWV0SnFLWG0tdW1ienVPTGFzNlhYYWxmQjNMOEs4WnZFdVY5cmJKMjI1NGRrY0dGSkRYdzBPeGdwa1pZbDJpQklIc044cEFWN01KS2xtNVhMX0xtalZSd014ZTA3UUZOQWlRZk9iTjNRaTg)）。此举将加剧半岛军备竞赛，并促使韩日强化反导与打击能力。
- **美空军远程导弹革命**：美空军发布“远程武器”项目，寻求空对空/空对地射程均超1000海里的下一代导弹，以应对中国海空力量（[Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOcFlHc213YXBiVkRpR2FhdGR2VlpEazJhak5LTlZfZDBqMHMtRVd4REp5eEdmOHJ6Y0hwOEJ2N0R2V04yeXZtUm1tWm00N21NbUJYQ2ZzR015YVdmR2oxYnZXRWpjQnlMbW85Ti1GanpiZ0p6VmdYZTdlSjRrS0RuVDFuX3NRelp5MHIxWTd4VW0)）。同时，美国批准向澳大利亚出口AIM-260，强化盟友空战能力（[19FortyFive](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)）。
- **霍尔木兹海峡航运承压**：伊朗袭击商船后，原定通过海峡的船舶计划暂停，航运恢复进程受阻（[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/plan-to-move-ships-through-strait-of-hormuz-paused-after-iran-strikes-cargo-vessel)）。战争对全球能源安全的影响日益显著。
- **菲律宾南海部署无人机**：菲律宾将美制“特里同”无人侦察机部署至西部海域，监视中国在黄岩岛设置的浮台（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/asia-pacific/2026/06/25/philippines-deploys-us-made-triton-naval-drones-in-its-western-waters-to-scout-for-intruders/)）。南海无人化对峙升级。
- **乌克兰无人机反导化**：乌克兰最大攻击无人机制造商Fire Point与德国Hensoldt合作生产“弗蕾亚”反导系统，将攻击无人机技术转向导弹防御（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/unmanned/2026/06/25/ukraines-top-strike-drone-maker-moves-into-ballistic-missile-defense/)）。
- **白俄准备扩大参战**：大西洋理事会分析称，白俄罗斯正秘密准备更深度介入俄乌战争（[Atlantic Council](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPM1R1bUpqcEhFMmZpNUVzaW1iWXY3ZU9xTGVHdXhOTHhDMkV1RXBrYVhvUGhCeXVtUkVPOHoyUkJEMVhuVzh0aUVYQmNpX3F6Qm90c1l3Wm9aMXk5NHRaei1lc2x2bFFsanJ5NW5HSnZiWElYdjFrNzBFZnNtNTVHdUtudkxra25yS1hjOHc2OXV1OUZUeEMxb3dzT0dCQXNDdk14Z1hyaVRKVlo0enhzQXZTMVlRWkNPYURLSEp4NE10d3c)）。
- **阿里巴巴起诉美国防部**：阿里巴巴正式起诉美国国防部，要求从“中国军事企业清单”中移除（[白鲸出海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5XVjlkVGJ5M3JWallXSjV4NV81LW02bEdySzg0UW1ZZm5uRmpWOUl0MHdXMVN5SGN2SGRrZVhBQnJweW90RjhoWE0tOWpGb1VlOGw2dmNKbkY)）；商务部回应将采取反制措施（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNNDJHTTR5VmJrQTVwMXJETTdFVUVFcnZGckt3UTJpUW1KMlE2UzhfTXNOUU5XakVfVGxUTEV4M0ZmRkFISVNnNmpUN0NjSmVhLUpVenJfem5yTW9jTmpjRW1JUVN3THAweU1OaEdWNlFXTTQzeS1DY0c4MGdUQnYtOC1IQkJ2ZGg2dGMtNnhKdEFzLXdCSnVJX05rX0hYNTBUQkdSLW5maEhyVmlwT0FPUw)）。

**后续观察**：朝鲜海军核武装化将引发东北亚新一轮军备竞赛，美日韩需调整威慑态势；美国远程导弹计划若落地，将根本改变空战与反介入博弈规则；伊朗战争对全球航运和能源价格的冲击仍在发酵，需密切关注霍尔木兹海峡通航状况及美军反应。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a flurry of strategic signalling and capability developments across multiple theaters. North Korea's commissioning of its first guided-missile destroyer and Kim Jong Un's call for a 'destructive' posture mark a significant escalation in naval nuclearisation. The U.S. Air Force has announced plans for a new 1,000-nautical-mile stand-off missile family, signaling a major shift in long-range precision strike to counter peer adversaries. Meanwhile, the Iran war continues to reshape energy security and naval traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, and Ukraine is innovating with drone-based ballistic missile defense and balloon-launched strike weapons. China is pushing back against U.S. sanctions lists and Japanese criticism of its defense spending, while the Philippines deploys U.S.-made naval drones in the South China Sea. The RIMPAC 2026 exercise kicks off in Hawaii, and a fire aboard USS Indianapolis underscores naval readiness concerns.

- North Korea commissions its 5,000-ton Choe Hyon-class destroyer and outlines plans for a 10,000-ton cruiser, with Kim linking the move to naval nuclearisation ([quwa.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOajJFMVZZckw1OHMzVFg4MW81WkdqRTFtdzRsYXRENkJkdnhzVmhmQUdGUWZEeUFYdVdSVDJHWGlRcUVwRHFPN0dveVkyU2JWYTctek4yVjVrSWdkR0Y4WVVJTWV0SnFLWG0tdW1ienVPTGFzNlhYYWxmQjNMOEs4WnZFdVY5cmJKMjI1NGRrY0dGSkRYdzBPeGdwa1pZbDJpQklIc044cEFWN01KS2xtNVhMX0xtalZSd014ZTA3UUZOQWlRZk9iTjNRaTg) | [ABC News](https://news.google.)).
- The U.S. Air Force is soliciting a new family of long-range missiles with a 1,000-nautical-mile range for both air-to-air and air-to-surface missions, explicitly to counter Chinese forces in a potential conflict ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/air-force-wants-new-1000-nautical-mile-range-missile-for-air-sea-targets) | [Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOcFlHc213YXBiVkRpR2FhdGR2VlpEazJhak5LTlZfZDBqMHMtRVd4REp5eEdmOHJ6Y0hwOEJ2N0R2V04yeXZtUm1tWm00N21NbUJYQ2ZzR015YVdmR2oxYnZXRWpjQnlMbW85Ti1GanpiZ0p6VmdYZTdlSjRrS0RuVDFuX3NRelp5MHIxWTd4VW0)).
- Iran's strike on a cargo vessel has paused a plan to move ships through the Strait of Hormuz, highlighting ongoing risks to global energy shipping ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/plan-to-move-ships-through-strait-of-hormuz-paused-after-iran-strikes-cargo-vessel)).
- Ukraine's top drone maker Fire Point is partnering with Germany's Hensoldt to build a ballistic missile defense system, while Kyiv fields new wind-drift balloons that bait Russian air defenses and launch missiles ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/unmanned/2026/06/25/ukraines-top-strike-drone-maker-moves-into-ballistic-missile-defense/) | [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/25/ukraines-newest-strike-weapon-drifts-into-russia-on-the-wind/)).
- China's Ministry of Commerce vows countermeasures after the U.S. adds firms to its 'Chinese military enterprise list'; Alibaba has formally sued the Pentagon to be removed ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNNDJHTTR5VmJrQTVwMXJETTdFVUVFcnZGckt3UTJpUW1KMlE2UzhfTXNOUU5XakVfVGxUTEV4M0ZmRkFISVNnNmpUN0NjSmVhLUpVenJfem5yTW9jTmpjRW1JUVN3THAweU1OaEdWNlFXTTQzeS1DY0c4MGdUQnYtOC1IQkJ2ZGg2dGMtNnhKdEFzLXdCSnVJX05rX0hYNTBUQkdSLW5maEhyVmlwT0FPUw) | [电子工程专辑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE9ZQmFjcTVuRXh6M1lnSEk5RV9pUkY1Y0owU1cyLThtS0RYMHljbkNaYTRBbWV5Y1NJbWM3ZmFkX1EtMXFmVzQyLXNmZlRxQnZ4dVBVWmdXM0VLVjd5)).
- The Philippines has deployed U.S.-made Triton naval drones in its western waters to monitor intrusions, following China's discreet installation of a floating platform at Scarborough Shoal ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/asia-pacific/2026/06/25/philippines-deploys-us-made-triton-naval-drones-in-its-western-waters-to-scout-for-intruders/)).
- RIMPAC 2026 has begun in Hawaii with 31 surface ships, 5 submarines, 197 aircraft, and 30,000 personnel from multiple nations ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/rimpac-2026-kicks-off-in-hawaii)).
- A fire aboard the Littoral Combat Ship USS Indianapolis at Mayport injured seven sailors, all treated and released ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/uss-indianapolis-suffers-fire-7-sailors-treated-for-minor-injuries)).

**Watch next:** The intersection of North Korea's naval nuclearisation and U.S. long-range missile plans will dominate strategic discussion. Monitor Iran's next moves in the Strait of Hormuz and whether China escalates its legal and diplomatic response to U.S. military lists. RIMPAC 2026 may reveal new coalition dynamics.

tech.zh: 今日科技新闻的核心矛盾集中在三条主线：**供应链危机推高硬件价格**、**AI监管博弈从企业自律转向行政干预**、**地缘政治加速新能源汽车市场壁垒**。内存危机（RAMaggeddon）成为最热词，苹果、微软、Valve等厂商被迫提价，[Prime Day成为消费者最后的捡漏窗口](https://www.wired.com/story/apple-price-hikes-on-macbooks-on-prime-day/)。AI领域，特朗普政府要求[OpenAI推迟GPT-5.6发布](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/the-white-house-is-asking-openai-to-slow-roll-the-release-of-its-new-model-over-safety-concerns/)，标志着安全监管从行业自律进入政府管控阶段。汽车方面，[Polestar因中国联网车辆规则被逐出美国市场](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/polestar-us-connected-vehicle-rule-europe/)，引发对科技脱钩连锁反应的担忧。此外，[Polymarket遭遇第三方黑客导致用户资金被盗](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/polymarket-says-hackers-stole-users-funds/)，[Anthropic Claude在付费消费者市场逆袭ChatGPT](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/anthropics-claude-is-winning-over-paid-consumers-a-market-owned-by-chatgpt/)，[CATL给固态电池泼冷水](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/catl-solid-state-battery-level-4-2030/)等事件值得关注。后续观察：Prime Day最后一天销量数据将验证消费者是否因涨价预期而抢购；GPT-5.6有限预览的反馈将影响AI行业安全标准讨论；Polestar会否通过法律或政治途径寻求豁免。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is defined by a severe component shortage ('RAMageddon') driving price hikes across Apple, Xbox, and Framework devices, while Prime Day deals offer temporary relief. Regulatory and geopolitical moves reshape the EV and AI sectors: the US bars Polestar over a new connected vehicle rule, and the White House asks OpenAI to delay GPT-5.6 over safety concerns. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude is gaining paid users, and Hacker News mourns the passing of tech luminary Om Malik.

- **Component crisis deepens**: Apple raised prices on nearly all MacBooks and the Xbox Series X/S will jump in August; Framework confirmed some preorder prices will drop due to component cost shifts. [RAMageddon just got extremely real](https://www.theverge.com/tech/956950/ram-crisis-apple-price-increase) | [Score a discounted Xbox console before the prices jump](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/957170/xbox-series-s-x-prime-day-deal-sale) | [Framework has good news and bad news](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/957338/framework-laptop-13-pro-ssd-price-cpu)
- **Polestar forced out of US market** after the Commerce Department denied authorization under the Connected Vehicle Rule – a dangerous precedent for Chinese-linked automakers. [Polestar barred from US over the Chinese connected vehicle rule](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/polestar-us-connected-vehicle-rule-europe/)
- **White House presses OpenAI to stagger GPT-5.6 release** over security concerns; OpenAI will limit initial access to a small group of partners. [The White House is asking OpenAI to slow roll the release of its new model](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/the-white-house-is-asking-openai-to-slow-roll-the-release-of-its-new-model-over-safety-concerns/) | [OpenAI will delay GPT-5.6 after Trump administration request](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/957372/openai-will-delay-gpt-5-6-after-trump-administration-request)
- **Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers**, eating into ChatGPT’s dominance as data shows a shift among those who pay for AI. [Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/anthropics-claude-is-winning-over-paid-consumers-a-market-owned-by-chatgpt/)
- **Polymarket says hackers stole users’ funds** – the prediction market giant will refund victims after a third-party breach. [Polymarket says hackers stole users’ funds](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/polymarket-says-hackers-stole-users-funds/)
- **EV market shakeup**: Subaru launches a 300-mile EV for $35,000; Range Rover’s first EV tops $150,000; CATL warns solid-state batteries are only at level 4 of 9 and unlikely to leap until 2030. [Subaru’s new top-selling EV delivers over 300 miles of range for just $35,000](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/subarus-new-top-selling-ev-300-miles-range-for-35k/) | [Range Rover’s first EV will beat its gas counterpart, but it may cost over $150,000](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/range-rovers-ev-beat-gas-model-cost-150000/) | [CATL chief: solid-state batteries at ‘level 4 of 9,’ no leap until 2030](https://electrek.co/2026/06/25/catl-solid-state-battery-level-4-2030/)
- **Hacker News community mourns Om Malik** – the influential tech blogger and investor has died at 60; the front page also highlights a deep dive on internet privacy’s ‘papers, please’ era. [Om Malik has died](https://om.co/2026/06/24/1966-2026/) | [The 'papers, please' era of the internet will decimate your privacy](https://expression.fire.org/p/the-papers-please-era-of-the-internet)
- **FCC may kill $2B program** that connects schools and libraries to the internet, citing screen time concerns – critics say Carr is acting as ‘the nation’s parent.’ [FCC may kill $2B program that connects schools and libraries to Internet](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/06/fcc-may-kill-2b-program-that-connects-schools-and-libraries-to-internet/)

**Watch next**: The interplay between the RAM crisis and consumer demand; further fallout from the US connected vehicle rule on global EV supply chains; and the White House’s growing role in shaping AI model releases. Also track the FTC’s stance on school internet funding and the real-world impact of Apple’s price hikes on PC market share.

### 体育新闻日报简报 · 2026-06-26

世界杯小组赛末轮战罢，冷门与戏剧齐飞：厄瓜多尔2-1逆转德国抢下淘汰赛门票，日本1-1瑞典携手晋级，美国二线阵容3-2惜败土耳其但无碍出线。NBA休赛期地震连连——拉梅洛·鲍尔转投森林狼，杰伦·布朗交易传闻持续发酵。羽毛球新加坡公开赛上演争议判罚翻盘。以下为本日关键动态。

- **世界杯：厄瓜多尔掀翻德国，美国练兵遇挫**——厄瓜多尔在77分钟由冈萨洛·普拉塔攻破诺伊尔球门，2-1逆袭德国，创下队史里程碑 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49179704/ecuador-germany-fifa-world-cup-2026-knockout-stage-group-e))。美国队虽0-3落后土尔其后扳回两球仍3-2落败，但主力轮休下主帅波切蒂诺考察了替补深度 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49183383/usmnt-heed-world-cup-lessons-learned-loss-turkiye))。日本与瑞典1-1战平，双双进入32强，瑞典将与美国同区 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cwy0lvr0wego))。
- **NBA重磅交易：拉梅洛·鲍尔赴明尼苏达**——黄蜂将拉梅洛·鲍尔与约什·格林送至森林狼，换来纳兹·里德及多个选秀权 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49175343/hornets-trade-ball-timberwolves-reid-picks))。同时，科迪·怀特以3年7400万留守黄蜂，马克·威廉姆斯3年3800万回归太阳，艾尔·霍福德2年1400万续约勇士 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49180880/sources-mark-williams-return-suns-3-year-38m-deal))。凯尔特人仍积极兜售杰伦·布朗，多队询价 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49173956/sources-celtics-remain-active-talks-trade-jaylen-brown))。
- **转会市场：安德森创纪录加盟曼城，普特拉斯登陆英女超**——曼城以俱乐部纪录转会费签下诺丁汉森林中场埃利奥特·安德森 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49179426/elliot-anderson-man-city-transfer-agreed-nottingham-forest-england))。金球奖得主阿莱西亚·普特拉斯结束14年巴萨生涯，与伦敦城狮女足达成协议 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49176078/alexia-putellas-reaches-agreement-london-city-lionesses-sources))。曼联接近将安德烈·奥纳纳再次租借至特拉布宗体育 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49177076/man-united-new-loan-deal-trabzonspor-andre-onana-sources))。
- **言论风波：施魏因斯泰格涉歧视发言引怒**——科特迪瓦主帅埃默斯·法埃公开批评前德国国脚施魏因斯泰格关于“非洲足球风格”的评论为“种族主义” ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49181018/ivory-coast-coach-slams-schweinsteiger-racist-african-football-comments))。该事件在世界杯期间发酵，引发对足球文化偏见的讨论。
- **羽毛球：乐蒂组合新加坡赛申诉遭无视后逆转**——2026新加坡公开赛首轮，马来西亚组合陈康乐/蒂娜在局点面临裁判争议判罚，申诉无效后强势翻盘取胜 ([Mshale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk))。印尼羽协公布26人亚洲青年锦标赛名单 ([VOI.id](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5ST3FQelVTQXJhWWJmeEMxQWEyOTBGSndCTnZIOG9Ba1RBQW1qMUxYdGk1eTRtT1FUeXRrYVZzNWFyTUVBemE2OXZn0gFCQVVfeXFMTmd6bk5RcDhMdzdHdjFmeWUtTndDMVUxdkhPMmFRTnBoeXFka2tqTW00ZWNfamQzQnRXOUZvMFhBRlNn))。

**后续观察**：世界杯淘汰赛首轮对阵出炉，美国vs波黑、荷兰vs摩洛哥等对决颇具看点；NBA自由市场即将于7月开启，拉梅洛交易可能触发连锁反应；曼城新援埃利奥特·安德森能否融入瓜迪奥拉体系值得跟踪；普特拉斯转战英女超将提升联赛关注度；足球领域种族议题因施魏因斯泰格言论再度升温。
sports.en:
Today's global sports coverage centers on the dramatic conclusion of World Cup group stages, where co-hosts USA stumbled but advanced, Ecuador stunned Germany, and Japan and Sweden secured knockout berths. The NBA offseason is in full swing with a blockbuster trade sending LaMelo Ball to Minnesota, while badminton fans track the Singapore Open and emerging talent. Chinese sports forums are buzzing with reactions to these events.

- **USMNT's Depth Tested**: A 3-2 loss to Turkey exposed vulnerabilities in Pochettino's second string, with backup goalkeeper Matt Turner rated 3/10 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49182087/usmnt-player-ratings-turner-3-10-first-world-cup-loss-turkiye)). Despite the defeat, the US advances to face Bosnia-Herzegovina in the round of 32 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49181937/usa-bosnia-herzegovina-world-cup-round-32-knockout)).
- **Ecuador's Historic Upset**: Gonzalo Plata's 77th-minute goal gave Ecuador a 2-1 win over Germany, propelling them into the knockout stage and leaving the four-time champions in jeopardy ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49179704/ecuador-germany-fifa-world-cup-2026-knockout-stage-group-e)).
- **Japan and Sweden Advance Together**: A 1-1 draw sent both teams through, with Japan set to face Brazil in the round of 32 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49181192/japan-brazil-2026-world-cup-round-32-sweden-knockout)).
- **Racism Controversy in Football**: Ivory Coast coach Emerse Faé accused Bastian Schweinsteiger of making 'racist' comments about African football style, sparking debate ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49181018/ivory-coast-coach-slams-schweinsteiger-racist-african-football-comments)).
- **NBA Trade Earthquake**: LaMelo Ball and Josh Green are traded from Charlotte to Minnesota for Naz Reid and draft picks; Hornets quickly re-sign Coby White to a three-year, $74M deal ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49175343/hornets-trade-ball-timberwolves-reid-picks), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49176539/sources-coby-white-re-sign-hornets-3-year-74m-deal)).
- **Wizards' No.1 Pick Debuts**: AJ Dybantsa unveils his No.4 Wizards jersey, aiming to revitalize the franchise ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49179050/aj-dybantsa-unveils-no-4-jersey-wizards-arrival-dc)).
- **Transfer Market Moves**: Manchester City agrees a club-record deal for Elliot Anderson ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49179426/elliot-anderson-man-city-transfer-agreed-nottingham-forest-england)), and Alexia Putellas signs with London City Lionesses ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49176078/alexia-putellas-reaches-agreement-london-city-lionesses-sources)).
- **Badminton Action**: The Singapore Open features a controversial match point call, while Indonesia announces a 26-player squad for the Asian Junior Championships ([Mshale](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBaaF9PZ2FaUzJGaENFX0d6Z1U3bUcxV28tU3JuN0NNSDhwMGt0MkE3ODJ0SmI2S2JpNFhWTXVic1NJRE5QZnlMMWNlV0c0b0cteU9SdXlOQmJHcVk), [VOI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5ST3FQelVTQXJhWWJmeEMxQWEyOTBGSndCTnZIOG9Ba1RBQW1qMUxYdGk1eTRtT1FUeXRrYVZzNWFyTUVBemE2OXZn0gFCQVVfeXFMTmd6bk5RcDhMdzdHdjFmeWUtTndDMVUxdkhPMmFRTnBoeXFka2tqTW00ZWNfamQzQnRXOUZvMFhBRlNn)).

**Watch next**: With the World Cup knockout round beginning, the USMNT's clash with Bosnia and the fallout from Germany's loss will dominate headlines. The NBA trade market remains fluid as Celtics continue Jaylen Brown talks, while badminton fans anticipate more upsets in Singapore.

今日欧美及东亚娱乐圈呈冷热交织态势：**好莱坞**迎来DGA合同获压倒性通过、Hulu台《The Bear》大结局引爆剧迷热议；**中国**影视业哀歌与流量话题并存——关于行业崩溃的刺耳论调刷屏，刘亦菲与金智秀的Dior代言攻防战则折射出韩流对国内市场的长期挤压；**日韩**方面，Goblin十周年重聚预告与ATEEZ北美综艺返场将经典延续与新生代扩张并置；**微博**热搜被白鹿彩排落泪、童锦程被曝私生子两件事撕裂。以下是各细分市场的关键信号。

- [《The Bear》大结局](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/the-bear-ending-explained-1236791040/)：Carmy最终选择“友谊即餐厅”，豆瓣评分回落至8.7，批评者指其过度煽情，但Hulu数据显示该剧创下平台单集同时在线人数纪录。
- [DGA合同正式生效](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/directors-guild-ratifies-four-year-contract-studios-1236631420/)：克里斯托弗·诺兰领衔的导演工会以“压倒性”票数通过四年新约，核心条款包括在制作低谷期保障会员就业岗位，好莱坞行业触底信号？
- [Mitchel Musso缺席《汉娜·蒙塔娜》20周年重聚](https://deadline.com/2026/06/hannah-montana-mitchel-musso-why-he-missed-20th-anniversary-1236968034/)：其本人声称“非因冲突，而是时机不对”，但粉丝猜测与他近年低调转型有关。
- [**中国影视“崩盘”论持续发酵**](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9MN0hXQnVMQVM0cUR0ajlFZHV0a3dxcTBRTE9fUmw4OVoyZ1VnZS1mdTV5QUx4S2xwcUNrWVVjeUI3VTVSSkdkYjlSUkdLZXdzMU1na1VlVGJvNUE)：有自媒体称“20万群演陷绝境”，但同日“2026中国影视之夜”仍聚集袁和平、倪大红等一线影人。行业真实图景是冰火两层。
- [Charli XCX发布新单《Wink Wink》MV](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-new-song-music-video-wink-wink-1235583175/)：歌词“Maybe I fucked your dad”延续挑衅风格，Rolling Stone称其为“从音乐到时尚的电影化跃进”。
- [Clive Davis葬礼阵容与家庭表演](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/clive-davis-funeral-alicia-keys-bruce-springsteen-1235584683/)：Alicia Keys、Bruce Springsteen等将出席，这或是音乐产业最后一次“老钱”聚会。
- 后续观察：欧美流媒体剧集内容供给在DGA稳约后可能加速；中国电影市场6月票房同比暴跌20%已成定局，但“出海”题材（如《给阿嬷的情书》）获得官方推流，对内“崩盘”与对外“输出”的叙事矛盾值得持续追踪。
entertainment.en:
Today's entertainment landscape is defined by a mix of labor stability, nostalgic conclusions, and simmering controversies across Hollywood, China, and Korea. The DGA ratified a critical four-year deal to protect jobs amid a historic production downturn, while 'The Bear' aired its tearful series finale. In China, the industry faces existential questions as a report claims 200,000 extras are out of work, even as stars like Liu Yifei and Jisoo battle for Dior's favor. K-pop fans track injury updates for TWS and legal wins for SEVENTEEN, while Weibo erupts over a child rumor involving streamer Tong Jincheng and actress Bai Lu's emotional rehearsal.

- [Directors Guild Ratifies Four-Year Deal Meant to Protect Members’ Jobs Amid Historic Downturn](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/dga-ratify-contract-four-year-1236789691/) and [Directors Guild Ratifies Four-Year Deal With Studios](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/directors-guild-ratifies-four-year-contract-studios-1236631420/) — The overwhelming approval signals industry solidarity as film and TV production remains sluggish.
- [‘The Bear’ Ends: Where Does Carmy Go and What Happens to the Restaurant?](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/the-bear-ending-explained-1236791040/) — The Hulu finale wraps up a critically acclaimed run with a focus on friendship over culinary success.
- [‘Hannah Montana’s Mitchel Musso On Why He Missed 20th Anniversary: “It Wasn’t The Right Thing”](https://deadline.com/2026/06/hannah-montana-mitchel-musso-why-he-missed-20th-anniversary-1236968034/) — Musso cites scheduling conflict, adding a note of regret to the otherwise star-studded reunion.
- [刘亦菲VS金智秀：Dior双代言背后的全球明星战争，谁主沉浮？](https://news.google.) — The Dior dual endorsement battle between Chinese and Korean stars reflects global brand power struggles.
- [中国影视彻底崩盘 20万群演陷绝境（视频）](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE9CdnNLdEswWS1lanJWS3JEclpEWVg2SGpSVGlfaEFPbXZPM3k1TG5GRWxZc1ZRbmRXX0tGdmNzaTQ2eG1zclZHNko1WEZ4cEpzVVJCWnI4UjUyOEIzZnF2S0RQX0F4Zw) — A dire report claims China's film industry is collapsing, leaving 200,000 extras jobless; the claim is contested but underscores deep anxiety.
- [TWS’s Youngjae To Modify Performances Due To Leg Injury](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850603wpp/twss-youngjae-to-modify-performances-due-to-leg-injury) — The K-pop group adjusts choreography after a thigh muscle injury during rehearsals.
- [🍍哭肿了已上热搜每次一播剧必发这种图](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBXVENtSWlRUlR6VWs4c1BDN0Z4V3RDanIzUWVTSjFqUmZvVDRlN2JUa2dUX2YxcHNZUV9pMDBiQjVZUzEtMEwxS1VfV19Gd0JqOFE0ZDY4RUxvRC1qWTRmSFd2Yw) — Actress Bai Lu's tearful rehearsal footage goes viral on Weibo, sparking debate about promotional tactics.

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the upcoming 'Kagurabachi' anime streaming deal with Crunchyroll, the Korean thriller 'The Husband' starring Namkoong Min, and the global rollout of Chinese film 'Letter to Grandma' as the industry tests international waters.

美股.zh: 美股三大期指周五盘前集体走低，科技股延续本周跌势。AI基建成本恐慌与联邦基金利率路径分歧构成双重压制。软银暴跌13%、SK海力士跟跌10%，资金从「算力受益者」撤向「物理AI并购」概念，ON Semi 70亿美元收购Synaptics虽获市场关注，但未能扭转做多情绪。[SoftBank plunges 13%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/global-tech-stocks-ai-infrastructure-costs-selloff-softbank-apple.html) 此外，芝加哥联储主席Goolsbee表示通胀仍过高、威廉姆斯则认为物价压力缓和，美联储内部分歧令利率路径更加模糊。[Goolsbee says inflation too high](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/25/chicago-fed-president-goolsbee-says-inflation-is-too-high-calls-warsh-a-serious-guy.html) 本周五也是FTSE Russell半年指数再平衡日，预计成交量大增，市场波动可能加剧。[Wall Street roster-cut day](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/the-wall-street-equivalent-of-roster-cut-day-happens-friday-itll-be-one-of-the-biggest-volume-days-of-the-year-750e8496) 短期美股偏向防御，关注核心PCE数据能否缓解估值压力。
美股.en:
US equity futures dropped on Friday morning as technology stocks struggled to recover from the week’s sharp selloff. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all pointed lower, with Big Tech and AI-related names under pressure following SoftBank’s 13% plunge in Asia. Meanwhile, a UN agency paused Hormuz ship evacuations after an attack, but oil prices continued to slide, suggesting markets are increasingly discounting Middle East risk.

- **Tech selloff deepens**: SoftBank Group plummeted 13% and SK Hynix lost 10% on concerns over rising AI infrastructure costs, dragging Asian tech stocks lower ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/global-tech-stocks-ai-infrastructure-costs-selloff-softbank-apple.html)). US-listed tech names are expected to follow.
- **Fed speakers split**: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee said inflation is too high but declined to comment on rate direction, while New York Fed’s Williams saw price pressures easing ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/25/chicago-fed-president-goolsbee-says-inflation-is-too-high-calls-warsh-a-serious-guy.html)).
- **ON Semi buys Synaptics for $7B**: The deal expands ON Semiconductor’s total addressable market by $30 billion to $243 billion by 2030, targeting physical AI applications ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/25/on-semi-synaptics-deal-physical-ai.html)).
- **Record rebalancing day**: FTSE Russell’s semi-annual reconstitution on Friday is expected to generate one of the highest volume days of the year, with potential for volatility ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/the-wall-street-equivalent-of-roster-cut-day-happens-friday-itll-be-one-of-the-biggest-volume-days-of-the-year-750e8496)).

**Bottom line**: The tech rout may deepen on Friday as index rebalancing amplifies moves, but falling oil prices could provide a cushion for broader markets.

欧洲经济.zh: 欧洲市场周五情绪分化：油价回落至伊朗战争前水平缓解了部分通胀焦虑，但消费者恐惧支出持续拖累复苏。ECB管委Schnabel强调即便在伊朗停火后仍需进一步收紧，暗示利率峰值可能高于预期。[ECB's Schnabel sees more tightening](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNMzR6T2RpMkdwcnM2VmFkVVVrVTFFOGpZOWloNmU3VWxXR2czdGsydU83TWthX2UyUU5NTjk5aDJheUVjenl4SUtJNUs4TVNHNHlhV1RmTmc5bnZmTE9tZm5rUEFkNDhnWUZ3dTRxV2FkMS1RcnpDTndhS3hEWjlHSnRrOFpfcGNJaHIxeDYyU1kydHd1TEc4) 欧盟方面，初步拟将亚马逊AWS和微软Azure纳入数字市场法案（DMA），这将重塑欧洲云服务竞争格局，相关美股可能面临合规成本上升风险。[Commission reaches preliminary position](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_) WSJ文章直指欧洲人「恐惧花钱」拖累经济，消费者信心低迷或令欧央行困境加深。[Europeans terrified of spending](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNVzktaU5FeG1nNnlsekpvN1hjWEVtMWtnY0Z0eWRaNUZuYXk5c204R1A3TFNSRVdRVWZ6M3RIQlZwaE9QZ2dlMjZrOFFtNnNzNGxfUkxsVXpfWUVyaElmTWN6NnVRLUJvTVZ3T1BzU29fT2FyQm9LNDBtcmlKLXNFODZzODFjZkVBWktjQ2lUYmdxRXAtbENlNEFDOXptdzNtb29WSHRCZEpKa2hxWTJmUw) 后续关注欧洲PMI初值及消费者信心数据落地。
欧洲经济.en:
European stocks edged higher on Thursday as oil’s retreat to pre-Iran-war levels eased inflation fears. ECB officials continued to signal a hawkish stance, with Schnabel calling for more tightening even after the ceasefire. A significant development emerged as the European Commission moved toward designating Amazon’s AWS and Microsoft’s Azure under the Digital Markets Act, which would impose strict operational rules.

- **ECB tightening not over**: ECB board member Isabel Schnabel said further tightening is needed despite the Iran ceasefire, citing persistent inflation pressure ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNMzR6T2RpMkdwcnM2VmFkVVVrVTFFOGpZOWloNmU3VWxXR2czdGsydU83TWthX2UyUU5NTjk5aDJheUVjenl4SUtJNUs4TVNHNHlhV1RmTmc5bnZmTE9tZm5rUEFkNDhnWUZ3dTRxV2FkMS1RcnpDTndhS3hEWjlHSnRrOFpfcGNJaHIxeDYyU1kydHd1TEc4)).
- **EU cloud regulation ramps up**: The European Commission reached a preliminary conclusion that AWS and Azure should be designated under the DMA, potentially forcing changes in data portability and interoperability ([Euractiv](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPYjJwTkZYOEI4NjByeTZnd3JhWkNKcVRidnk2VU95Q1RYZTZmV0pPR0Z2djh2SlYtc1hXQUpQc2dMTGp4b3RveTlLTXZmUmpSbkdqSF9CTHBzZGRuQ0hLcEhKSFVNeWYxb1ItRHoyRDZDYXIzT2VmMVlEYlJLSHQ4Nld0a2ZEdTVQcHhsZ3laQW51ekxZakFZVHV6TFotU0tv)).
- **Consumer spending fears**: A WSJ report highlighted that Europeans are terrified of spending money, weighing on the region’s economic recovery ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNVzktaU5FeG1nNnlsekpvN1hjWEVtMWtnY0Z0eWRaNUZuYXk5c204R1A3TFNSRVdRVWZ6M3RIQlZwaE9QZ2dlMjZrOFFtNnNzNGxfUkxsVXpfWUVyaElmTWN6NnVRLUJvTVZ3T1BzU29fT2FyQm9LNDBtcmlKLXNFODZzODFjZkVBWktjQ2lUYmdxRXAtbENlNEFDOXptdzNtb29WSHRCZEpKa2hxWTJmUw)).
- **TotalEnergies climate ruling**: A Paris court ruled the oil major must disclose climate risks related to its products, a partial victory for the city and NGOs ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/25/paris-partial-victory-totalenergies-climate-risks-case)).

**Bottom line**: Hawkish ECB and cautious consumers keep European growth under pressure, but regulatory momentum against Big Tech could reshape competitive dynamics.

中国经济.zh: 恒生指数周五重挫2.3%，周跌幅可能达5.8%，科技权重股领跌引发市场对AI估值泡沫的担忧。[Hang Seng heads for worst week](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358428/hang-seng-index-heads-worst-week-over-year-renewed-sell-engulfs-tech-names) 同时A股成交突破2.5万亿元，但万亿龙头股大跌，AI板块拖累指数创阶段新低。[A股成交额突破2.5万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5wN0psRzdURHUzTTBPS21RUnJnQVRhMkJfTHJYcVB3Ym95alF3cC02VmZ4bWRRVmc2eXkzekE1OVhaZDNablJvck81SlhwazFkQUNJ) 结构上，半导体领域出现积极信号：国家大基金通过科创板最大并购案成为中芯国际第三大股东，[Big Fund becomes SMIC third-largest](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3358332/chinas-big-fund-becomes-smics-third-largest-shareholder-after-record-star-market-buyout) 显示政策对自主芯片的支持未减。港股方面，港交所推出首只追踪HKEX Tech 100指数的ETF，[HKEX welcomes first ETF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQRlR0Ty0zWlFQUzljTmRzUDEtRUw0bHhHRERuMW8zNjBFaXdlVmpVVFFTUWNZb3lkUU8zNnhPLUlHSkVGMUM5NHZjZTJhUTVtNk44aThaNkFpVmxfVzB4UnJOSTBQZzhzSnFYM0E1cEdnSjhoUlB2eU9qcGV1elVhTUlNVl94dThodTJNdVJFbXRtY1dWUGY5dy1DLUNnYldBLUctM3pZUnhfN1NhZ3BibVlxaGxVbTRkaWpTeHhFSlhiUQ) 旨在重塑AI行情下的指数生态。短期市场情绪脆弱，但汽车价格战（156款新车涌入）可能为有成本优势的龙头提供整合机会。
中国经济.en:
Chinese and Hong Kong markets suffered heavy losses on Friday, led by a sell-off in technology stocks. The Hang Seng Index fell 2.3% to 22,538, on track for its worst week in over a year. Mainland A-share turnover surged past 2.5 trillion yuan, with a trillion-yuan market cap heavyweight dropping sharply. Meanwhile, structural shifts continued: HKEX launched its first ETF tracking the Tech 100 Index, and a record wave of new car models raised concerns about a brutal price war.

- **Tech rout hits China**: AI-related shares drove Chinese stocks to new lows, with the Hang Seng down 5.8% for the week ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358428/hang-seng-index-heads-worst-week-over-year-renewed-sell-engulfs-tech-names)). A-share turnover exceeded 2.5 trillion yuan, the highest in recent memory, driven by a trillion-yuan stock’s sharp drop ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9jR29NaExuX2pIa01qdXNIN0xyRmdjV1pRdWdINFhZUDdkbHJkSlpicEQ3MEd1aU1SRlBiQV9NSXFJcDY4WDBiYUxRWWw1cVlYSkk5SWstQlVjMWw4MXl0c0xn)).
- **Auto price war intensifies**: A record 156 new models will hit the Chinese market in H2 2026, with mass-market EVs priced around 100,000 yuan. Only leading OEMs with strong brands are likely to survive ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358193/do-or-die-small-carmakers-china-market-braces-156-new-models-price-war-looms)).
- **Trip.com antitrust warning**: The online travel giant faces a 'significant fine' from China’s market regulator and guided Q2 revenue growth of only 3–8%, its slowest in three years ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3358354/chinas-tripcom-faces-revenue-slowdown-warns-significant-fine-antitrust-probe)).
- **SMIC gets Big Fund backing**: China’s state-backed Big Fund became SMIC’s third-largest shareholder after the company completed a record Star Market buyout ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3358332/chinas-big-fund-becomes-smics-third-largest-shareholder-after-record-star-market-buyout)).
- **HKEX expands index offerings**: The exchange launched its first ETF tracking the HKEX Tech 100 Index, aiming to capture the AI-driven tech rally that traditional indices have missed ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3358375/hkex-pushes-deeper-index-business-ai-reshapes-hong-kong-market)).

**Bottom line**: China’s equity markets face headwinds from global tech weakness and domestic competition, but state-backed investment in semiconductors and new financial products signal long-term strategic bets.

同花顺社区动态.zh: 同花顺社区舆情显示投资者关注点转向外资动向与大宗商品异动。摩根士丹利和高盛的调仓曝光引发跟风讨论，[外资动了！摩根士丹利、高盛调仓动向曝光](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE55cWxsYURZMFhYR25rOEYtLVktTmFMX1RlU1l6d1RRbnJIZHI0RHMyZXN4TzVXRGpLNFJQa3JySzZORERuMmtGRUJTY1hET0duNS0yLTVqS1ZGck5wVGYwX3F3) 投资者可借此参考外资对中国科技股的重新定价。大宗方面，黄金ETF持仓减少6.27吨，[全球最大黄金ETF持仓减少](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5CYXNrUExtNngwZkVTUjlaTkNJOElLRjdGQzR5SWdZWVRPR1lTTjJ6Z2l6YlB5Q1BvQjc1RlFnTHBGallURW9QZTVwRUN1ZGNvbG5qcFVDUDNzaXpVeFE) 结合油价回落，避险资产热度有所降温。另外深圳通报房地产违规自媒体案例，[深圳通报房地产领域违规自媒体账号典型案例](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5aa1VWUUEzWU0taW14T3hxZEdaUmREOWJPMzh2NzlDTU51TUhVeFhiRTJIY000dDRQbndIQ2xPZlBhbTBENVhDZDhodlFKUVU3V21POUlBalNKNFMzNlc2Y3pB) 反映政策层面仍严控楼市预期炒作。关注周一6月29日16城39宗地块挂牌结果，将对地产股形成短期催化。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Retail investor sentiment on Tonghuashun was mixed amid the market rout, with volume-driven chatter around a sharp drop in a trillion-yuan market cap stock and heavy turnover. Community discussions also tracked foreign fund flows, with Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs adjusting their positions. Key commodity price alerts included white-feathered broiler chicks and palm oil, while gold ETF holdings declined.

- **Trillion-yuan stock plunges**: A major heavyweight saw heavy selling, becoming the highest-turnover stock on the A-share market, sparking intense discussion among retail investors ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9jR29NaExuX2pIa01qdXNIN0xyRmdjV1pRdWdINFhZUDdkbHJkSlpicEQ3MEd1aU1SRlBiQV9NSXFJcDY4WDBiYUxRWWw1cVlYSkk5SWstQlVjMWw4MXl0c0xn?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans)).
- **Foreign capital moves**: Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs revealed their latest position adjustments, with community participants analyzing which stocks are being favored by foreign capital ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE55cWxsYURZMFhYR25rOEYtLVktTmFMX1RlU1l6d1RRbnJIZHI0RHMyZXN4TzVXRGpLNFJQa3JySzZORERuMmtGRUJTY1hET0duNS0yLTVqS1ZGck5wVGYwX3F3?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans)).
- **Gold ETF holdings decline**: SPDR Gold Trust holdings dropped by 6.27 tonnes, signaling reduced safe-haven demand despite geopolitical tensions ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5CYXNrUExtNngwZkVTUjlaTkNJOElLRjdGQzR5SWdZWVRPR1lTTjJ6Z2l6YlB5Q1BvQjc1RlFnTHBGallURW9QZTVwRUN1ZGNvbG5qcFVDUDNzaXpVeFE?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans)).
- **Commodity price alerts**: The community flagged price changes in white-feathered broiler chick prices and palm oil, with traders watching for short-term volatility ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5BY3FlMDFTcl9rRWk3b3NZMlRxbWJwRkM1c3ZKSXZCaklDcThMNDJOeXBoNDV2ank3NTdyZ3NBYW5yOTZQeE1na1ctQklGMWNRY2lTamJtbXAyZEl6Q2c?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans) & [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1HTEZsa3lSbEw5WU82UU1kdGVhaTEyMnlqSU9lTmVJNjVrOHpUNExQNW5FcHROaVBXbTFkVjlfVURHYVhTVDRiSFpHV1R2dEJ3a1o2OWM4MUU1UVhZUmRDUkJR?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans)).
- **Shenzhen warns on real estate misinformation**: Authorities flagged and penalized social media accounts posting false property market information ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5aa1VWUUEzWU0taW14T3hxZEdaUmREOWJPMzh2NzlDTU51TUhVeFhiRTJIY000dDRQbndIQ2xPZlBhbTBENVhDZDhodlFKUVU3V21POUlBalNKNFMzNlc2Y3pB?hl=zh-CN&gl=CN&ceid=CN%3Azh-Hans)).

**Bottom line**: The community is hyper-focused on large-cap volatility and foreign positioning, with commodity price moves offering short-term trading cues, but overall sentiment remains cautious amid the broader selloff.

欧美.zh: 欧美板块今日焦点集中于三重叠加危机：**委内瑞拉地震**（7.2级与7.5级双震，致235死，4300伤）在政治真空下救援艰难，引发对国际援助效率的质疑 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3vynpw7rk4o))；**美国最高法院**支持特朗普政府终止海地和叙利亚移民的临时保护身份（TPS），影响数十万人，人权组织称将导致“系统性的驱逐” ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/26/us-ends-deportation-protections-tps-for-haitians-and-syrians?traffic_source=rss))；**特朗普与国会及北约的裂痕**——要求数千亿美元对伊朗战争拨款遭共和党内部抵制，同时指责北约未提供支持 ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/25/nx-s1-5869806/trump-airs-grievances-with-nato-chief-over-alliances-lack-of-iran-war-support))。此外，欧洲热浪东移，巴黎限制酒精销售以减轻医院压力 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwy0pdq89zno))；法国50余名女性联名呼吁废除性侵诉讼时效 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg7z5dvxnzo))。欧美当前处于“地缘冲突+气候变化+司法激变”的多重压力下，政策张力明显加剧。
欧美.en:
The Western hemisphere is reeling from a major earthquake disaster and sharpening political confrontations. The 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes in Venezuela have killed at least 235 and injured over 4,300, hitting a country already in crisis after the US seizure of former leader Maduro. In the US, President Trump is demanding billions for a war with Iran, but faces pushback from his own party, and the Supreme Court has cleared termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and Syrians. Europe is battling a severe heatwave, with Paris restricting alcohol sales. Meanwhile, Israel's ongoing conflicts show no end, and women in France are calling for abolition of rape statute of limitations.

- [Venezuela quake: rescues ongoing as death toll rises](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjegdqw5d3yo) — 235 dead, 4,300 injured; buildings collapse in Caracas; quakes come months after Maduro's seizure.
- [Trump's Iran war budget faces Republican skepticism](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1eydwldzdjo) — The president airs grievances with NATO chief over lack of allied support.
- [Supreme Court sides with Trump on ending TPS for Haitians and Syrians](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/26/us-ends-deportation-protections-tps-for-haitians-and-syrians) — Hundreds of thousands face deportation after years in the US.
- [Israel's 'forever wars' continue without clear end](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/26/forever-wars-israels-conflict-cycle-shows-no-finish-line) — Analysis finds no lasting security gains despite ceasefires.
- [Paris restricts alcohol as heatwave moves east](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwy0pdq89zno) — Temperatures near 40°C in Germany; alcohol rules to reduce hospital strain.

The coming days will test whether the Trump administration can secure war funding and manage the domestic fallout from mass deportations, while Venezuela faces a humanitarian catastrophe.

日韩.zh: 日韩板块核心动向是**安全合作升温**：日本防卫大臣本周末访问首尔，与韩国国防部长会晤，拟签署《获取与交叉服务协定》（ACSA），实现后勤与弹药互供，被视为应对外部威胁的实质性突破 ([每日新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTFBTZkQzUmJoTVd5dlZWeEhpV1NNeEpvTEcyajVaeXJ5eGVoX21JYmYwRnNheTJyeUM2aUVPX1RkVFpjMldFd1poQTZkbUdjT3l0LXd0RlJITHh0am1mU1VRakM5a25wcFp5S21FZ1RoZVRRU3M))。另外，**日本北部发生7.2级地震**，但暂无重大伤亡报告 ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQbzhwZmw3M3RqVi04T1l4MjNNcTE2Q1JzZlR6dUxhVW9oTkxBUkdzYTdFd1N1aElPaS1PeERtME1UTXNDQXpQTWRkRGFpZ3YxcWhPRmpQV2EwTGx1S2dOSEFrWDdhbkxCdFFPVmZWVVZQc3VBdlFBR2xWWGh4T2FkOVFn))；日本男足在世界杯小组赛战平瑞典晋级16强，引发国内欢庆 ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQNjFPdkFJZ2ZnM3dsekVDLTN3RjFWVkRscG1uTzJyclR4aFk2LU1EdU1jRUx0ekVyVTZ6ZHhMR1R2WjR3LUE5aWZkNlJvN2paT1FkeTdYSGcwaFNpdUN5ZVQwR2k5bnN5SWNGTy14RGtjdG5WMEZ5ZE14RHZNVHZNeTctR0FqYVN2XzlLb2puLW81SmNWdFhpdHE0cnNUOXBxS1E))。此外，群马县一起女性被刺死案嫌犯在逃逸中车祸身亡，案件细节待披露 ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxNdmdLdWQtTzA3M1FMdlNRUDhCOFJhN195ZXlGZTd3SWVQanJzVC04U0gxaUpacmVPd2NKM3RobkExQlI2VUdyMVBocFhPNEZTTGF0dkNHTGVCTmxwM1ptRk5GV1MyZ0JkTTZSOXIzdDdQazdZbmtTdUVsb25aYm5LcXZhNkk5bnhtS3FvN2lqYy1sbWo2))。日韩安全合作加速，是对区域安全环境变化的直接回应，但国内社会事件（如地震、案件）仍提醒民众关注内政风险。
日韩.en:
Northeast Asian security cooperation is deepening as Japan's defense minister prepares to visit Seoul this weekend for talks with his South Korean counterpart, focusing on expanded military ties and possibly a new Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement. Concurrently, a 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck northern Japan (Hokkaido region), though no major casualties have been reported yet. Japan's national mood was lifted by the national soccer team advancing to the World Cup knockout stage. Markets in Asia fell sharply as traders booked profits from the AI-driven rally, with a 2.14% drop in Shanghai's composite index also noted.

- [Japan, South Korea defense chiefs to meet in Seoul](https://news.google.) — Talks this weekend on expanded security cooperation, possibly including logistics agreements.
- [Magnitude 7.2 quake hits northern Japan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQbzhwZmw3M3RqVi04T1l4MjNNcTE2Q1JzZlR6dUxhVW9oTkxBUkdzYTdFd1N1aElPaS1PeERtME1UTXNDQXpQTWRkRGFpZ3YxcWhPRmpQV2EwTGx1S2dOSEFrWDdhbkxCdFFPVmZWVVZQc3VBdlFBR2xWWGh4T2FkOVFn) — Shallow quake; no immediate reports of major damage but aftershocks expected.
- [Japan advances to World Cup knockout stage](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxQNjFPdkFJZ2ZnM3dsekVDLTN3RjFWVkRscG1uTzJyclR4aFk2LU1EdU1jRUx0ekVyVTZ6ZHhMR1R2WjR3LUE5aWZkNlJvN2paT1FkeTdYSGcwaFNpdUN5ZVQwR2k5bnN5SWNGTy14RGtjdG5WMEZ5ZE14RHZNVHZNeTctR0FqYVN2XzlLb2puLW81SmNWdFhpdHE0cnNUOXBxS1E) — Draw with Sweden secures place; national celebration amidst broader news.
- [Asian shares plunge as AI rally profits taken](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxONTRRYVQ4QUJiei1SWHd1V3pjUnBUeGkxTkRfLWhPb0Y5ajIwZTFKMUw5YmlRZ05xa0ZwRkVvT1RuUHBFNllOYUROMXpxdXRrUzJUU0dXTkdlWjlNVXcyY1FVQ1lDdEd4SmROV2RpdDVaMlhVVlNGTHJPYjZTVUVOVU54WjJYdmIwR1o1NzZqUm5mT0hmSmE3Z3BVOVdVbjVxb2hMMjlZZFNGYXhGbE9UNGhRZnE2VnVtOVZvanZMSE1xdw) — Markets sell off after recent AI-driven gains; caution ahead.

With defense talks and a fresh earthquake, the region's attention will be split between diplomatic signals and disaster preparedness.

中国.zh: 中国社会新闻今日以**政策宣传与主题报道**为主，但有两则值得关注：一是新华网发布的《跌入蛛网的青春——部分青少年吸食“新型毒品”调查》，揭露了隐蔽毒品渗透校园的现状，具有高度现实警示意义 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwTEQzM1JqY0x3YTN3cDdwdEhyWWxrQ0FOaTNVUGJ2UEF4ZU82YmM2c2RGQXpMeC1yb3I3Q3dnbmdnSkc3UkJrZWV6T2Y0Nk1rN1ZjSXprTW9Ga19LWTB2SjdvcnhERHJhaUZtVl9RaHNXYXdyRzVJQXRaR2MtQQ))；二是美敦力高管顾宇韶表态称“中国正成为医疗创新重要策源地”，反映跨国企业对华医疗市场战略定位的调整 ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5LU2R0NVlKRTI1WnhHSDVNRGNpUGNKdlR3bDNNUHAyeW9HaFBhQWNnWGJCMEdqOTV0YzJ6TGtuWlRnS21TY3pOajFJYU1jaU96aUstbFZnQjE3M1gtRi1rV3NRS0UyQ2dNY2JaSmVWb3BQdGhuM2RQVTZQZVBmQQ))。其他如“富民厚生”、“伟大征程”、“六部门美丽中国建设”等均为常规意识形态宣传。股市方面，沪指半日跌2.14%，教育板块逆势走强 ([中国经济网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9FTnltX3Y3YlE5Y0JjWDJQb1QxSXhtbnVFRmF2bUZVdzAxR2FhOVZWaVVBbktSMm1ROEQycWI3OGs3Q3JVSnR2R3Z6dDdXUTFlRzdQb1VNTzZvYjBlc05mdlBxUEJ3aDFqSmV0NVVRblMxUQ))。总体而言，官方叙事仍占主导，但民间关注点开始向毒品治理、留学租房、医疗创新等具体议题倾斜，说明舆论场正出现微观分化。
中国.en:
China's official media continues a heavy focus on ideological education and party history, with multiple outlets running 'Great Journey' series and calls to strengthen socialist core values. However, a notable investigative report from Xinhua reveals a growing problem of 'new-type drugs' among adolescents, providing rare social criticism. The Shanghai composite index fell 2.14% in morning trading, in line with broader Asian market declines. On the business front, Medtronic's Asia head praised China as a rising source of medical innovation.

- [Youth drug abuse investigation: 'Fall into spider web'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwTEQzM1JqY0x3YTN3cDdwdEhyWWxrQ0FOaTNVUGJ2UEF4ZU82YmM2c2RGQXpMeC1yb3I3Q3dnbmdnSkc3UkJrZWV6T2Y0Nk1rN1ZjSXprTW9Ga19LWTB2SjdvcnhERHJhaUZtVl9RaHNXYXdyRzVJQXRaR2MtQQ) — Xinhua reports on rising synthetic drug use among young people, a sensitive topic.
- [Shanghai index drops 2.14% amid global sell-off](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9FTnltX3Y3YlE5Y0JjWDJQb1QxSXhtbnVFRmF2bUZVdzAxR2FhOVZWaVVBbktSMm1ROEQycWI3OGs3Q3JVSnR2R3Z6dDdXUTFlRzdQb1VNTzZvYjBlc05mdlBxUEJ3aDFqSmV0NVVRblMxUQ) — Education sector bucked the trend with gains amid broader weakness.
- [Medtronic executive: China becoming medical innovation hub](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5LU2R0NVlKRTI1WnhHSDVNRGNpUGNKdlR3bDNNUHAyeW9HaFBhQWNnWGJCMEdqOTV0YzJ6TGtuWlRnS21TY3pOajFJYU1jaU96aUstbFZnQjE3M1gtRi1rV3NRS0UyQ2dNY2JaSmVWb3BQdGhuM2RQVTZQZVBmQQ) — Positive foreign investment signal amid challenging economic environment.
- [Six departments issue plan for 'Beautiful China' action](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPb0xDcDhKelRkY1h6REFKdmdNQUpxV1Z3LWNNV3RicnJNY2VGdDYyb05xb1ZScklocFVMc3FLTGdhS09WXzRUOHk2WUFJeVpzMWJxZ2RmcTFYMENoNFdERDFndjU2ZnoxZ1VRalZKU1VVNHlqUlBhT0xDaDVRa2FYZGt4Q1FXYTB1dHk5aw) — Environmental campaign aimed at mass participation, likely tied to propaganda goals.

The gap between official narratives and real social issues remains stark; the drug survey suggests authorities are willing to acknowledge certain problems even as they double down on ideological messaging.

知乎社区动态.zh: 知乎社区动态今日的核心信号是**平台商业化转型的阵痛与尝试**：知乎2025年营收同比下滑23.6%，CEO周源明确表示将加速AI商业化探索 ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))；同时知乎联合AWE发布报告显示“AI家电”搜索量同比增长1343% ([品玩](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5WeVFSMkZxUkdHUHRSWkVrZzdOVWtucERLMzIwM1VBSmM5Z0tjVU4yd3NKb1dyVXAzVEJYU3lxcG1zUGhrY0pyTA))，暗示AI内容社区潜力。娱乐类内容方面，郭京飞谭卓三搭悬疑剧引发讨论 ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNYkRGeFZKYzVKMXdoWHIwQWJwcGpHTkZMc1FZOWFpMTdsblhjSmhQbFBJTG5pQTNmdEF4VmFaQVl6Q1BOaVpreGpFbzN4VWhScG41X2lQdlRKbTlRYWtCaG5VbFN0dW1qRXBRamoyOF9JWHNmN1p6aTVVam56SjNoU2VMb2VTVUJzUVdVLVN6cjNqcWZNaHNacGdyNV9odUhaUmRLSk45MW41eVd4dlFpejgtTkdHeld0))；赵丽颖老剧翻红，年轻观众涌入，被解读为“实力派回归” ([360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5QSzN5ekJjZTFXNGlhVlNQd0gxWTZ3SUFKaVBpT1dxZXdNYUQzdUJaaTJDSGpXRjU1a1oxaEFGRW5iM3ZmX1F6bVZpZmd3V2s))。此外，《红楼知乎：大学毕业生租房避坑指南》切中毕业季刚需 ([湖南红网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5MWHhtbGVvRVZSbmFuLW8zX295TnJFLWFBSGVjbVQ2TW8wNmtYeVhBeWFOczlsZm1FLS1UREVsWTB0NEtYNWRYOVU3WWJaQmxCNlA1a1U2ckpOamtwdkxqb3plVQ))。知乎需要在“内容社区本质”与“AI变现压力”之间找到平衡，否则用户活跃度可能进一步流失。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu, the Chinese Q&A platform, is in the spotlight for its declining revenues and pivot to AI. The platform reported a 23.6% drop in 2025 revenue, with CEO Zhou Yuan promising accelerated AI commercialization. A joint report with AWE found 'AI home appliance' searches surged 1,343%. Entertainment content dominates community chatter, with a nostalgic revival of older dramas by Zhao Liying and discussions about 'Zhen Huan' behind-the-scenes details. Practical guides, such as a rental guide for graduates, also trend.

- [Zhihu 2025 revenue down 23.6%, CEO pushes AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ) — The company's financial struggles underscore the need to find new growth drivers beyond traditional content.
- [AI home appliance searches on Zhihu up 1,343%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5WeVFSMkZxUkdHUHRSWkVrZzdOVWtucERLMzIwM1VBSmM5Z0tjVU4yd3NKb1dyVXAzVEJYU3lxcG1zUGhrY0pyTA) — Joint report with AWE indicates strong consumer interest in AI-integrated products.
- [Zhao Liying's old dramas go viral among younger audiences](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5QSzN5ekJjZTFXNGlhVlNQd0gxWTZ3SUFKaVBpT1dxZXdNYUQzdUJaaTJDSGpXRjU1a1oxaEFGRW5iM3ZmX1F6bVZpZmd3V2s) — Classic content outperforming new releases, reflecting shifting viewer preferences.
- [Graduate rental guide: avoiding traps](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5MWHhtbGVvRVZSbmFuLW8zX295TnJFLWFBSGVjbVQ2TW8wNmtYeVhBeWFOczlsZm1FLS1UREVsWTB0NEtYNWRYOVU3WWJaQmxCNlA1a1U2ckpOamtwdkxqb3plVQ) — Practical advice for young job seekers entering the rental market.

Zhihu's pivot to AI and the resurgence of nostalgic content signal a platform in transition, trying to retain users while chasing revenue from new technologies.

国际安全.zh:
今日国际安全领域多重信号同时释放：朝鲜首次列装“崔贤”级驱逐舰并宣布建造万吨巡洋舰，金正恩明确海军核武装化方向（[quwa.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOajJFMVZZckw1OHMzVFg4MW81WkdqRTFtdzRsYXRENkJkdnhzVmhmQUdGUWZEeUFYdVdSVDJHWGlRcUVwRHFPN0dveVkyU2JWYTctek4yVjVrSWdkR0Y4WVVJTWV0SnFLWG0tdW1ienVPTGFzNlhYYWxmQjNMOEs4WnZFdVY5cmJKMjI1NGRrY0dGSkRYdzBPeGdwa1pZbDJpQklIc044cEFWN01KS2xtNVhMX0xtalZSd014ZTA3UUZOQWlRZk9iTjNRaTg)）；美国空军发布1000海里远程导弹需求，意在对抗中国“反介入/区域拒止”能力（[Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOcFlHc213YXBiVkRpR2FhdGR2VlpEazJhak5LTlZfZDBqMHMtRVd4REp5eEdmOHJ6Y0hwOEJ2N0R2V04yeXZtUm1tWm00N21NbUJYQ2ZzR015YVdmR2oxYnZXRWpjQnlMbW85Ti1GanpiZ0p6VmdYZTdlSjRrS0RuVDFuX3NRelp5MHIxWTd4VW0)）；霍尔木兹海峡在伊朗袭击商船后暂停船舶调度，能源通道安全面临直接威胁（[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/plan-to-move-ships-through-strait-of-hormuz-paused-after-iran-strikes-cargo-vessel)）。此外，美国批准向土耳其出口F110发动机供KAAN战斗机使用，可能为F-35回归铺路（[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/trump-set-to-clear-critical-f110-turbofan-engine-sale-for-turkeys-kaan-fighter)）。

- **朝鲜海军核化**：6月23日朝鲜列装5000吨级“崔贤”级驱逐舰，并宣布后续万吨巡洋舰计划，金正恩强调海军核武装（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/north-korea-commissions-first-guided-missile-destroyer-plans-cruiser/)）。
- **美空军远程打击**：美空军寻求射程1000海里的空对空/空对地导弹，以支持“近邻防御”场景（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/air-force-wants-new-1000-nautical-mile-range-missile-for-air-sea-targets)）。
- **霍尔木兹海峡中断**：伊朗攻击商船导致原本恢复通行的计划搁浅，航运风险骤增（[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/plan-to-move-ships-through-strait-of-hormuz-paused-after-iran-strikes-cargo-vessel)）。
- **美土引擎交易**：特朗普政府批准F110发动机对土出口，缓解土耳其KAAN项目瓶颈，北约内部关系或有转机（[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/trump-set-to-clear-critical-f110-turbofan-engine-sale-for-turkeys-kaan-fighter)）。

收束判断：大国军备竞赛与地区冲突同步升温，远程打击能力和海军核化趋势将重塑未来安全格局。
国际安全.en:
Global security headlines are dominated by two parallel trends: North Korea's aggressive naval modernisation linked to tactical nuclear weapons, and a rapid U.S. push for extreme-range stand-off missiles designed for a potential conflict with China. Meanwhile, the Iran war continues to disrupt maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, and Ukraine is fielding novel drone and balloon systems that are reshaping the air defense battlefield.

- North Korea commissioned its first Choe Hyon-class guided-missile destroyer (5,000 tons) and announced plans for a 10,000-ton cruiser. Kim Jong Un explicitly tied this to naval nuclearisation, calling for a 'destructive' military posture as South Korea responds with drone reinforcements ([quwa.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOajJFMVZZckw1OHMzVFg4MW81WkdqRTFtdzRsYXRENkJkdnhzVmhmQUdGUWZEeUFYdVdSVDJHWGlRcUVwRHFPN0dveVkyU2JWYTctek4yVjVrSWdkR0Y4WVVJTWV0SnFLWG0tdW1ienVPTGFzNlhYYWxmQjNMOEs4WnZFdVY5cmJKMjI1NGRrY0dGSkRYdzBPeGdwa1pZbDJpQklIc044cEFWN01KS2xtNVhMX0xtalZSd014ZTA3UUZOQWlRZk9iTjNRaTg) | [ABC News](https://news.google.)).
- The U.S. Air Force is seeking a next-generation stand-off missile with a 1,000-nautical-mile range for both air-to-air and air-to-surface roles, explicitly to counter Chinese air and naval forces. The move leapfrogs existing AMRAAM and JASSM capabilities ([Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOcFlHc213YXBiVkRpR2FhdGR2VlpEazJhak5LTlZfZDBqMHMtRVd4REp5eEdmOHJ6Y0hwOEJ2N0R2V04yeXZtUm1tWm00N21NbUJYQ2ZzR015YVdmR2oxYnZXRWpjQnlMbW85Ti1GanpiZ0p6VmdYZTdlSjRrS0RuVDFuX3NRelp5MHIxWTd4VW0) | [USNI News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQUkFodHNSbE5VNmRWZWowT2dwRFdFMG40ekZ0MVRrM0o5UDBXcG5OVWM0ZWdyMTlZZnFCUEFQR2lHZ01sWUp5SHctOXZoTnl0TEJpZXQ0TEtzeUxCVW85MEdPa3Q5YnhVMXgwYXBNaktScXdNMkZHQlhycm9EQkxmSGJQWlM2QWhpcXRWOE9VcXNqYmFMNEhodUQyb2ZHTDJ2U21pMmpvQ04)).
- Iran struck a cargo vessel, causing a pause in convoy plans through the Strait of Hormuz. This follows a period of resumed shipping, highlighting the fragility of energy transit in the region ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/plan-to-move-ships-through-strait-of-hormuz-paused-after-iran-strikes-cargo-vessel)).
- Ukraine's Fire Point, the top strike-drone maker, is partnering with Germany's Hensoldt to build a homegrown ballistic missile defense system called Freyja. Separately, Ukraine is using wind-carried balloons to bait Russian air defenses and launch missiles — a tactic also adopted by the U.S. and Russia ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/unmanned/2026/06/25/ukraines-top-strike-drone-maker-moves-into-ballistic-missile-defense/) | [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/25/ukraines-newest-strike-weapon-drifts-into-russia-on-the-wind/)).
- The White House is proposing to raid Navy E-2 Hawkeye funds to pay for USAF E-7 Wedgetail aircraft, an ironic reversal of earlier Pentagon plans to cancel the E-7 ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/in-an-ironic-turn-of-events-white-house-wants-to-raid-navy-e-2-account-to-pay-for-usaf-e-7s)).

**Signal:** North Korea's naval nuclearisation and the U.S. missile range race are creating a new axis of strategic competition; the Iran situation remains a wildcard for global energy markets.

冲突局势.zh:
乌克兰和伊朗两大战场出现新变量。乌克兰方面，俄军被迫将防空力量回撤以保护莫斯科，显示乌无人机打击取得战略效果（[PBS](https://news.google.)）；乌克兰最大攻击无人机厂商Fire Point与德国Hensoldt合作生产“弗蕾亚”反导系统，从进攻转向防御（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/unmanned/2026/06/25/ukraines-top-strike-drone-maker-moves-into-ballistic-missile-defense/)）。伊朗战争方面，分析认为美国未能消除伊朗“超级武器”反而催生了新威胁（[Derek Thompson](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE12VWtESTIzb045X0JBVGZ0Mm53Qnl3UXJtUlMtTUVKSXpscVY1blgxb3pRcUNZVVQteXp4dGpFbUZucG9sWDZmRWxzMlVJbWVVTHl0eXZBOTRHb0d6aE1NNTFuazZ5Y25EY0R3S2RCLVhIRmROb2dv)），且战争正重塑全球能源地缘格局（[The National Interest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPM1pXdHQwSW1jLTZJZ2VMU2ZxY1RqRnpuWWcxRS1EUWdLb0czSDN6V1daVFR3Sk54R2NnV1hIN2ZFTEVncENibXdKVG9UZEdLdS0tNl9OR0tLbmxVTVR2Y0ZBcGQyTERJSHJnakdjWlIwSks1QWJZOFVEOFd3VjBrQXF6SURrUm4wbUh6OXNwQUNuUG54MlJEZjFhNzlXY2NhX0sxM1ZrOVlJbW1PQXlsQW5FMTREQQ)）。此外，白俄罗斯正秘密准备扩大参与俄乌战争（[Atlantic Council](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPM1R1bUpqcEhFMmZpNUVzaW1iWXY3ZU9xTGVHdXhOTHhDMkV1RXBrYVhvUGhCeXVtUkVPOHoyUkJEMVhuVzh0aUVYQmNpX3F6Qm90c1l3Wm9aMXk5NHRaei1lc2x2bFFsanJ5NW5HSnZiWElYdjFrNzBFZnNtNTVHdUtudkxra25yS1hjOHc2OXV1OUZUeEMxb3dzT0dCQXNDdk14Z1hyaVRKVlo0enhzQXZTMVlRWkNPYURLSEp4NE10d3c)）。

- **俄防空回缩**：泽连斯基称俄为保护莫斯科调回部分防空力量，揭示乌无人机远程打击效果（[PBS](https://news.google.)）。
- **乌克兰无人机反导化**：Fire Point与德国Hensoldt合作开发“弗蕾亚”反导系统，标志技术路线从攻击向防御延伸（[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/unmanned/2026/06/25/ukraines-top-strike-drone-maker-moves-into-ballistic-missile-defense/)）。
- **白俄准备扩大战争参与**：分析认为白俄罗斯正悄然为更深入介入乌克兰战争做准备（[Atlantic Council](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPM1R1bUpqcEhFMmZpNUVzaW1iWXY3ZU9xTGVHdXhOTHhDMkV1RXBrYVhvUGhCeXVtUkVPOHoyUkJEMVhuVzh0aUVYQmNpX3F6Qm90c1l3Wm9aMXk5NHRaei1lc2x2bFFsanJ5NW5HSnZiWElYdjFrNzBFZnNtNTVHdUtudkxra25yS1hjOHc2OXV1OUZUeEMxb3dzT0dCQXNDdk14Z1hyaVRKVlo0enhzQXZTMVlRWkNPYURLSEp4NE10d3c)）。
- **伊朗战争教训**：分析指出美国未能消除伊朗“超级武器”反而催生新威胁（[Derek Thompson](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE12VWtESTIzb045X0JBVGZ0Mm53Qnl3UXJtUlMtTUVKSXpscVY1blgxb3pRcUNZVVQteXp4dGpFbUZucG9sWDZmRWxzMlVJbWVVTHl0eXZBOTRHb0d6aE1NNTFuazZ5Y25EY0R3S2RCLVhIRmROb2dv)）；能源安全因地缘冲突而动荡（[The National Interest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPM1pXdHQwSW1jLTZJZ2VMU2ZxY1RqRnpuWWcxRS1EUWdLb0czSDN6V1daVFR3Sk54R2NnV1hIN2ZFTEVncENibXdKVG9UZEdLdS0tNl9OR0tLbmxVTVR2Y0ZBcGQyTERJSHJnakdjWlIwSks1QWJZOFVEOFd3VjBrQXF6SURrUm4wbUh6OXNwQUNuUG54MlJEZjFhNzlXY2NhX0sxM1ZrOVlJbW1PQXlsQW5FMTREQQ)）。

收束判断：乌克兰战场技术外溢与伊朗战争的地缘经济后果将成为未来数月关注重点。
冲突局势.en:
The evolving conflict landscape shows Europe grappling with NATO dependency versus autonomy ambitions, while the war in Iran is producing second-order effects on great power dynamics and energy security. Belarus is quietly preparing a larger role in Russia's Ukraine war, and Ukraine's battlefield innovations are outpacing NATO's formal development processes.

- A Eurasia Review analysis warns that Europe remains trapped between ambitions for strategic autonomy and deep dependence on U.S. security guarantees, a tension amplified by the Iran war and the Ukraine conflict ([Eurasia Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQMDNOVEplMnJqaHFSZFgydFBVNnV6ZTBiV1lzRzNoR3NTYkdNZHJsWlh6MjNvRUdDb0VVQm9PNlJvQmlrd1h1RnN4RHZkazJzMkxvUElDQjk1bmtUZnlibkVpRVhLNTljSDJqaUxaTl9qU0VPNkdqMVhUNEpWdFhYNU5XalVZcG16dXU1X0UzYlVHeGtwbTFpM0l3aEtvRDFRZ0tjSC1HZXhwT2ZqZ3lIS3YxMA)).
- The Soufan Center examines the great power implications of the war in Iran, noting how it reshapes alliances and arms flows beyond the immediate theater ([The Soufan Center](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83aDI3cWE0aEtyNTdYU1RzWXQ4cXdRMWl2TTVSY05vQkZiamZ1ZGM4YXhvYkVQMzhsRUpDa0FjR05MNUhPXzZKeE5fQWFDVGlHV2xld3BhNnhVQlFfdU9iUDB3)).
- Belarus is quietly preparing to increase its military role in Russia's war against Ukraine, with potential implications for NATO's eastern flank ([Atlantic Council](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxPM1R1bUpqcEhFMmZpNUVzaW1iWXY3ZU9xTGVHdXhOTHhDMkV1RXBrYVhvUGhCeXVtUkVPOHoyUkJEMVhuVzh0aUVYQmNpX3F6Qm90c1l3Wm9aMXk5NHRaei1lc2x2bFFsanJ5NW5HSnZiWElYdjFrNzBFZnNtNTVHdUtudkxra25yS1hjOHc2OXV1OUZUeEMxb3dzT0dCQXNDdk14Z1hyaVRKVlo0enhzQXZTMVlRWkNPYURLSEp4NE10d3c)).
- A Ukrainian commander expressed unease about NATO's approach to developing naval drones, suggesting a mismatch between alliance processes and real combat requirements in the Black Sea ([Business Insider](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOOXVXcmpaRzU5dWdDcWJRcExYWEc1aER1cXYyZ2l5ZHZ4QVZ3OFNiT2V1XzBMLWdOclNUc3ZZV05HaUdBeEJEMnVxalMtd3haYXJpaHl3RFN5YXVXUVR0MFpnanZwTXNNdWxDSENKSEVFOER4YXJNdHhlbFdPeXJFSnpRZUJxS2daVVZQUHBWS3g)).
- News analysis argues that the U.S. war in Iran inadvertently gave Tehran a new superweapon, referring to the strategic consequences of military failure in the missile duel ([Derek Thompson | Substack](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE12VWtESTIzb045X0JBVGZ0Mm53Qnl3UXJtUlMtTUVKSXpscVY1blgxb3pRcUNZVVQteXp4dGpFbUZucG9sWDZmRWxzMlVJbWVVTHl0eXZBOTRHb0d6aE1NNTFuazZ5Y25EY0R3S2RCLVhIRmROb2dv)).

**Signal:** The Ukraine conflict continues to drive asymmetric innovation and expose NATO's structural inertia, while Belarus's deepening involvement could open a new front.

中国军情.zh:
中美在军事与科技领域的博弈进一步激化。阿里巴巴正式起诉美国国防部，要求将其从“中国军事企业清单”中移除（[白鲸出海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5XVjlkVGJ5M3JWallXSjV4NV81LW02bEdySzg0UW1ZZm5uRmpWOUl0MHdXMVN5SGN2SGRrZVhBQnJweW90RjhoWE0tOWpGb1VlOGw2dmNKbkY)）；商务部强硬回应称美方做法破坏市场规则，中方不得不反制（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNNDJHTTR5VmJrQTVwMXJETTdFVUVFcnZGckt3UTJpUW1KMlE2UzhfTXNOUU5XakVfVGxUTEV4M0ZmRkFISVNnNmpUN0NjSmVhLUpVenJfem5yTW9jTmpjRW1JUVN3THAweU1OaEdWNlFXTTQzeS1DY0c4MGdUQnYtOC1IQkJ2ZGg2dGMtNnhKdEFzLXdCSnVJX05rX0hYNTBUQkdSLW5maEhyVmlwT0FPUw)）。国防部针对日本质疑中国国防开支，批驳日方用“阴谋论”抹黑并掩饰自身“再军事化”野心（[香港電台](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRDV2VXQtZHBKWDFVbWkxNHl4cElRNTdHYjdUcVBzaHZIbW5WR2NnUWJ1SWhZNGpNejhjdWg2d2V6M1VLaG5uLTJjc042Z3VXYzBmeHBNZktxTDd4U0Q2blBGOUZDSENpdVhVdzhab0tOa1RJMkFWTTBXM24tT1JTOURhWnQ4SXdrX19R)）。南海方向，中国科研团队发现蓝洞，意在宣示科考能力与主权权益（[中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE96SllaTFIyczJ3ZnRRNmdwby1RWkR3akZvWFdPVE5Qa2R4c3h0QmxSU3pkVXdJX1V0V2tTWmJicG9UOTR2Nzd5RGlBWklqQmdGRU83WlItd3lQUUM3a3pRaUZfUjJsWDlsMlE)）。

- **阿里巴巴诉国防部**：阿里在美起诉要求移除“军事企业清单”，体现中国科技企业以法律手段反击制裁（[白鲸出海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5XVjlkVGJ5M3JWallXSjV4NV81LW02bEdySzg0UW1ZZm5uRmpWOUl0MHdXMVN5SGN2SGRrZVhBQnJweW90RjhoWE0tOWpGb1VlOGw2dmNKbkY)、[电子工程专辑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE9ZQmFjcTVuRXh6M1lnSEk5RV9pUkY1Y0owU1cyLThtS0RYMHljbkNaYTRBbWV5Y1NJbWM3ZmFkX1EtMXFmVzQyLXNmZlRxQnZ4dVBVWmdXM0VLVjd5)）。
- **商务部反制表态**：商务部回应美方增列清单，强调中方将采取必要反制措施（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNNDJHTTR5VmJrQTVwMXJETTdFVUVFcnZGckt3UTJpUW1KMlE2UzhfTXNOUU5XakVfVGxUTEV4M0ZmRkFISVNnNmpUN0NjSmVhLUpVenJfem5yTW9jTmpjRW1JUVN3THAweU1OaEdWNlFXTTQzeS1DY0c4MGdUQnYtOC1IQkJ2ZGg2dGMtNnhKdEFzLXdCSnVJX05rX0hYNTBUQkdSLW5maEhyVmlwT0FPUw)）。
- **国防部批日本**：针对日本称中国国防开支“不透明”，国防部反驳日方“阴谋论”实为掩饰自身再军事化（[香港電台](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRDV2VXQtZHBKWDFVbWkxNHl4cElRNTdHYjdUcVBzaHZIbW5WR2NnUWJ1SWhZNGpNejhjdWg2d2V6M1VLaG5uLTJjc042Z3VXYzBmeHBNZktxTDd4U0Q2blBGOUZDSENpdVhVdzhab0tOa1RJMkFWTTBXM24tT1JTOURhWnQ4SXdrX19R)）。
- **南海科考维权**：中国发现蓝洞展示科考能力，维护南海权益（[中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE96SllaTFIyczJ3ZnRRNmdwby1RWkR3akZvWFdPVE5Qa2R4c3h0QmxSU3pkVXdJX1V0V2tTWmJicG9UOTR2Nzd5RGlBWklqQmdGRU83WlItd3lQUUM3a3pRaUZfUjJsWDlsMlE)）。

收束判断：中美科技脱钩风险加剧，中国通过法律和外交双轨应对，南海主权博弈持续升温。
中国军情.en:
China is pushing back on multiple fronts: legal action against U.S. sanctions, diplomatic rebuttals to Japanese criticism, and symbolic demonstrations of sovereignty in the South China Sea. The Ministry of Commerce has vowed countermeasures after the U.S. expanded its 'Chinese military enterprise list,' and Alibaba has formally sued the Pentagon to be removed from that list.

- Alibaba has filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense, demanding removal from the 'Chinese military enterprise list' ([白鲸出海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5XVjlkVGJ5M3JWallXSjV4NV81LW02bEdySzg0UW1ZZm5uRmpWOUl0MHdXMVN5SGN2SGRrZVhBQnJweW90RjhoWE0tOWpGb1VlOGw2dmNKbkY) | [电子工程专辑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE9ZQmFjcTVuRXh6M1lnSEk5RV9pUkY1Y0owU1cyLThtS0RYMHljbkNaYTRBbWV5Y1NJbWM3ZmFkX1EtMXFmVzQyLXNmZlRxQnZ4dVBVWmdXM0VLVjd5)).
- The Ministry of Commerce stated that China has to take countermeasures in response to the U.S. addition of firms to the 'Chinese military enterprise list' ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNNDJHTTR5VmJrQTVwMXJETTdFVUVFcnZGckt3UTJpUW1KMlE2UzhfTXNOUU5XakVfVGxUTEV4M0ZmRkFISVNnNmpUN0NjSmVhLUpVenJfem5yTW9jTmpjRW1JUVN3THAweU1OaEdWNlFXTTQzeS1DY0c4MGdUQnYtOC1IQkJ2ZGg2dGMtNnhKdEFzLXdCSnVJX05rX0hYNTBUQkdSLW5maEhyVmlwT0FPUw)).
- The Chinese Ministry of National Defense accused Japan of using 'conspiracy theories' to smear China's defense spending and cover up Japan's own remilitarization ([香港電台](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRDV2VXQtZHBKWDFVbWkxNHl4cElRNTdHYjdUcVBzaHZIbW5WR2NnUWJ1SWhZNGpNejhjdWg2d2V6M1VLaG5uLTJjc042Z3VXYzBmeHBNZktxTDd4U0Q2blBGOUZDSENpdVhVdzhab0tOa1RJMkFWTTBXM24tT1JTOURhWnQ4SXdrX19R) | [新浪军事](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBZX1EtN0V1M0pENnhYQUZheDdlY2tGZ3U4cGxtOG9vRXlYTVNmcWZnaFRuLWJJdm0zT2RQb2NkdGxSR21lamhmR0tHZ3ZDTktxRkEzbElrWlVTSU1qcTY5SFJITndPTWJGQkkwSy1WQ2t3alhTM1ZiTmlaZTg)).
- A blue hole discovery in the South China Sea is being used by Chinese state media to highlight scientific research and demonstrate China's ability to safeguard its maritime rights ([中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE96SllaTFIyczJ3ZnRRNmdwby1RWkR3akZvWFdPVE5Qa2R4c3h0QmxSU3pkVXdJX1V0V2tTWmJicG9UOTR2Nzd5RGlBWklqQmdGRU83WlItd3lQUUM3a3pRaUZfUjJsWDlsMlE)).

**Signal:** China is hardening its legal and rhetorical stance against U.S. designation of military-linked firms, while reinforcing its territorial claims in the South China Sea through both hard and soft power.

海军与印太.zh:
太平洋方向进入年度军演节奏，同时朝鲜海军动向引发关注。环太平洋军演（RIMPAC）2026在夏威夷开幕，31国参与，共31艘水面舰、5艘潜艇、197架飞机及3万人（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/rimpac-2026-kicks-off-in-hawaii)）。朝鲜则同步展示海军扩张能力：6月23日正式列装首艘5000吨级“崔贤”级导弹驱逐舰，并宣布后续万吨巡洋舰计划（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/north-korea-commissions-first-guided-missile-destroyer-plans-cruiser/)）。美军方面，LCS“印第安纳波利斯”号在港内发生火灾，7名水兵轻伤已出院（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/uss-indianapolis-suffers-fire-7-sailors-treated-for-minor-injuries)）。美国国会发布THAAD系统报告（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/report-to-congress-on-thaad-system)），强调其在反导体系中的地位。此外，比利时-荷兰联合扫雷项目进入关键集成阶段（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/belgian-dutch-rmcm-programme-enters-critical-integration-phase/)），科威特海军为AL DORRA巡逻舰采购SPYNEL红外监视系统（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hgh-to-provide-spynel-surveillance-systems-for-kuwait-navys-al-dorra-opv-program/)）。

- **RIMPAC 2026开幕**：6月25日在夏威夷启动，规模庞大，展示多国海军合作威慑能力（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/rimpac-2026-kicks-off-in-hawaii)）。
- **朝鲜海军大型化**：朝鲜列装5000吨驱逐舰并计划万吨巡洋舰，标志其海军战略转型（[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/north-korea-commissions-first-guided-missile-destroyer-plans-cruiser/)）。
- **美LCS火灾**：“印第安纳波利斯”号在梅波特港内起火，7人轻伤，暴露濒海战斗舰维护问题（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/uss-indianapolis-suffers-fire-7-sailors-treated-for-minor-injuries)）。
- **THAAD报告**：国会研究服务局发布THAAD系统报告，强调其射程150-200公里及“命中即摧毁”能力（[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/report-to-congress-on-thaad-system)）。

收束判断：印太海上力量竞赛加剧，朝鲜海军突破性发展可能倒逼美日韩调整反导与反舰部署。
海军与印太.en:
The Indo-Pacific naval domain is defined by major exercises and capability developments. RIMPAC 2026 has begun, North Korea unveiled its largest warship, and the U.S. Air Force is seeking long-range missiles specifically for maritime strike. A fire aboard USS Indianapolis and the deployment of THAAD reports also feature.

- The U.S. Air Force wants a family of next-generation missiles with 1,000-nautical-mile range to strike Chinese naval and air targets, part of the Long Range Weapon program ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/air-force-wants-new-1000-nautical-mile-range-missile-for-air-sea-targets)).
- North Korea formally commissioned its 5,000-ton Choe Hyon-class guided-missile destroyer on June 23, and announced plans for a future 10,000-ton cruiser class. This represents a major leap in DPRK surface combatant capability ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/north-korea-commissions-first-guided-missile-destroyer-plans-cruiser/)).
- RIMPAC 2026 kicked off in Hawaii with 31 surface ships, 5 submarines, 197 aircraft, and 30,000 personnel from allied and partner nations ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/rimpac-2026-kicks-off-in-hawaii)).
- The Littoral Combat Ship USS Indianapolis (LCS-17) suffered a fire in port at Mayport; seven sailors were treated for minor injuries and released. Cause under investigation ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/uss-indianapolis-suffers-fire-7-sailors-treated-for-minor-injuries)).
- A new Congressional Research Service report details the THAAD system’s capabilities and limitations, including its 150-200 km engagement range, relevant to theater missile defense in the Indo-Pacific ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/25/report-to-congress-on-thaad-system)).
- Kuwait Navy’s AL DORRA OPV program will equip eight vessels with HGH SPYNEL 360° infrared surveillance systems, enhancing Gulf maritime domain awareness ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hgh-to-provide-spynel-surveillance-systems-for-kuwait-navys-al-dorra-opv-program/)).

**Signal:** The combination of North Korea's new destroyer, U.S. long-range missile plans, and RIMPAC drills underscores a heightened readiness posture across the Indo-Pacific; the USS Indianapolis fire reminds that readiness is still challenged by maintenance and safety issues.

科技产品.zh: 内存危机（RAMaggeddon）全面冲击消费电子，苹果、微软、Valve等多品牌宣布涨价，[Prime Day成为短期内入手新设备的最后窗口](https://www.theverge.com/tech/957151/ram-crisis-component-shortage-prices-computer-apple-microsoft-valve)。Android 17为折叠屏加入专属游戏模式，YouTube Shorts进一步TikTok化，Instagram电视版意图垄断客厅注意力。精选：1. [RAMageddon just got extremely real](https://www.theverge.com/tech/956950/ram-crisis-apple-price-increase) 2. [Apple MacBook price hikes & Prime Day deals](https://www.wired.com/story/apple-price-hikes-on-macbooks-on-prime-day/) 3. [Android 17 foldable gaming mode](https://www.theverge.com/tech/957450/android-17-foldable-gaming-mode-virtual-controller) 4. [Framework Laptop 13 Pro 好消息与坏消息](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/957338/framework-laptop-13-pro-ssd-price-cpu) 5. [Polymarket 黑客事件](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/polymarket-says-hackers-stole-users-funds/)。收束：内存短缺短期内无缓解趋势，消费者若需新设备应抓住当前Prime Day促销，但需警惕后续涨价潮。
科技产品.en:
The component shortage continues to dominate consumer tech, with Apple, Microsoft (Xbox), and Framework all announcing price increases. Prime Day offers a temporary reprieve, but the underlying RAMageddon suggests higher prices will persist. Meanwhile, security and regulatory news also hit the desk: Polymarket suffers a third-party breach, and the FCC may terminate a $2B school internet program.

- **Apple jacks up MacBook prices** – new models cost significantly more, making current Prime Day discounts unusually attractive. [This Is Probably Your Last Chance to Buy a Cheap MacBook for a While](https://www.wired.com/story/apple-price-hikes-on-macbooks-on-prime-day/) | [RAMageddon just got extremely real](https://www.theverge.com/tech/956950/ram-crisis-apple-price-increase)
- **Xbox and Framework also feel the pinch** – Microsoft will raise Xbox prices in August; Framework lowers prices on some preorders due to shifting component costs. [Score a discounted Xbox console before the prices jump](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/957170/xbox-series-s-x-prime-day-deal-sale) | [Framework has good news and bad news](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/957338/framework-laptop-13-pro-ssd-price-cpu)
- **Polymarket hacked** – prediction market refunds users after third-party breach, raising questions about crypto platform security. [Polymarket says hackers stole users’ funds](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/25/polymarket-says-hackers-stole-users-funds/)
- **Android 17 adds foldable gaming mode** – virtual controller on half the screen aims to enhance gameplay on flippy devices. [Android 17’s new foldable gaming mode could make flippy phones more fun](https://www.theverge.com/tech/957450/android-17-foldable-gaming-mode-virtual-controller)
- **YouTube Shorts gets even more TikTok-like** – new clear screen mode, heart icon, 2x speed playback.
